symptom: ako/mxcli#1632: a view entity query's comment before the first token or after the last was dropped — from a script, and from every describe → exec into another project (pre-fix binary: 0 of 4 comments kept on 11.7.0). Separately, a comment BETWEEN clauses was stored, passed check and exec, and then failed mx check below 11.7 with CE0174 "Error(s) in OQL query: The '-' part is incomplete or incorrect"
cause: ExitCreateViewEntityStatement stored extractOriginalText(oqlCtx) — the first-to-last token span — and the lexer `-> skip`s LINE_COMMENT and BLOCK_COMMENT, so outer comments were outside every span. Nothing knew that OQL comments are version-dependent: Mendix accepts them from 11.7.0 only, in any position, whatever UseOQLVersion2 says
file: mdl/visitor/visitor_entity.go (viewQueryText, firstOuterComment, lastOuterCommentEnd, lineIndentBefore), mdl/executor/version_gates.go (oql_functions.comments gate on CreateViewEntityStmt), sdk/versions/mendix-11.yaml
fix: The stored query is widened over comments between `as (`/`as` and the first token and between the last token and `)` (whitespace semantics unchanged, so #653's dedent holds); a query containing a comment (stripOQLComments(q) != q, so `'--'` in a string is not one) is refused by check -p and exec below 11.7.0 (MDL-VERSION01)
insight: **The real run reversed the issue's premise.** The obvious fix — keep the comment — turned working 10.x scripts into CE0174, because Mendix below 11.7 rejects OQL comments ANYWHERE; the silent drop of an OUTER comment had been accidentally protective, and the defect that actually broke builds was the INTERIOR comment mxcli always kept (the #653 fixtures even store `-- every sale`). Unit tests passed for all of it; only `mxcli docker check` could say. **Measure the floor, then read the notes**: 10.24.25 and 11.6.6 reject (comment-free control 0 errors), 11.7.0 and 11.13.0 accept; the docs say 11.7.0 too, but the bracket is what makes the gate load-bearing. UseOQLVersion2 was true on all four, so the obvious setting is not the discriminator. **Two traps on 11.x controls**: `Target` is reserved in 11.x OQL ("The 'Target' part is incomplete" on the comment-free control too) — rename test entities before believing a negative; and a planted comment-free control is what separates 'comments rejected' from 'my query is wrong'. Positions are RUNE indices in ANTLR's InputStream, so scan []rune, not the UTF-8 string. Gate on a comment, not on the characters: reuse stripOQLComments, which skips string literals
